newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps mostly dip, bar fuel, June mogas.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps mostly dip, bar fuel, June mogas.

text.p: European oil swaps were steady to weaker on Thursday although heavy fuel bucked the trend for part of the day by posting $2 gains.

But crude's consolidating weakness wore away at morning gains and heavy fuel swaps ended the day much as they had started. June gasoline resisted the pull south as the approach of the UK budget on July 2 gave support. Traders said excise was expected to increase.
Brent CFDs lost a few cents in a slow afternoon.
Front month gasoline resisted the draw lower that further out gasoline could not while naphtha dropped $3 a tonne.

Traders said high sulphur June swaps were concluded at $85.25 and $85.75 following on from morning barge trades as high as $87. July swaps were in a 50 cent contango against the prompt month with August showing a 75 cent premium to July.
Low sulphur had another poor day with levels broadly unchanged around the $93/93 level for June.

Physical gasoline saw a flurry of barges finding homes from $200 for stored Antwerp material up to $205.75 for Rotterdam refinery product. Swaps activity was less noticeable although August was done at $188.75. June swaps continue to see the July 2 UK budget, and its expected increase in excise, as a supporting crutch.
Brent CFDs extended early week losses slipping six cents or so with June 9-13 pegged around -48/49 cents under July.
A June 26-July 2 CFD was done at August -47 cents while June 30-July 4 was done at August -47 cents for half a boatload and -46 cents, again for half a boat.
The gas oil crack spread came off a touch with 4Q at $4.70, 1Q98 at $4.65, 2Q98 at $4.10 and 3Q98 around $4.40. Dealers said deals were done, but privately.
A jet 3Q swaps was done at $21.75 and a 4Q EN590 went at $10.25.
"The EN590 is a lot quieter after the rash of deals yesterday (at $10.50)," one dealer said.
Naphtha swaps took their cue from crude and headed southwards dropping up to $3 a tonne. Business was quiet although July was done at $185.
